apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
#### Improved

* A refreshed design across Home, Albums, Activity, Settings, onboarding, and backup details, with calmer colors, consistent cards, more space, and clearer actions.
* Home puts the current backup status and next step first. Album management, recent uploads, backup history, and long-backup controls remain easy to reach.
* Plain-language labels and summaries make everyday use easier. Advanced settings, full upload errors, and verification details remain available when needed.
* Album selection is clearer, backup preferences include a preview and a persistent Save button, and onboarding lists all available albums.
* Better support for larger text, accessible controls, and dark appearance, including readable primary buttons.
* Updated help references to match the new screen and setting names.

#### Notes

* Version **0.4.1**, build **19**. This update focuses on presentation; existing backup settings, account identity, and saved history are preserved.
* A clear activity list still does not claim that every selected photo is backed up. Backup details distinguish local history from Google confirmations.
* Validation passed 346 offline simulator tests and 8 protocol tests. Visual checks covered light and dark appearance and larger text on an iOS 27 simulator. Live Google uploads, physical-device behavior, and iOS 15 runtime behavior were not tested.
* Install the unsigned IPA through SideStore or AltStore, which signs it with your Apple ID. GitHub Actions builds the release from this tag using Xcode 26.3 and attaches its SHA-256 checksum. The installation feed updates after the IPA is uploaded.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Mxlted/PhotosBackup/compare/0.4.0...0.4.1)
